keyConfirmations: The official paired assessment has 96 positive pairs and 72 negative pairs.
The Likert section has 25 scored statements, not 31.
All Likert statements are positive/direct, scored 1 to 5, equal weight.
The five questions in each Likert dimension are averaged and then normalized using the corresponding norm.
The new Excel contains the official current norm.
Reactive-to-scale assignment does not change from the previously validated version.
